episode_title: The booming cash advance industry trapping America’s small businesses
script_en: The booming cash advance industry trapping America’s small businesses.
What would you do if a financial deal you believed was a lifeline blew up your life?
When a California entrepreneur landed in the world of merchant cash advances, he found America’s fastest-growing — and least regulated — source of funding for small businesses.
Its daily payments and broken promises left him a changed man, back in his teenage bedroom, over $5 million in debt.
NPR business correspondent Alina Selyukh joins The Sunday Story to trace his stubborn battle against an industry where borrowers rarely fight back.
